services.title: Our Services
services.subtitle: Comprehensive solutions for your business needs

dialerAuto.title: Auto Dialer System
dialerAuto.description: A solution designed to increase reach rates quickly and with minimal operational effort. Automatically launches calls on customer lists, matches each caller with the most suitable agent based on skills and current load. Supports voice messages for campaigns and offers, precise scheduling inside/outside working hours, with instant reports on success, missed calls, duration, and conversion rates. Seamlessly integrates with CRM to ensure opportunity follow-up and result documentation without manual work.

ivr.title: Interactive Voice Response (IVR)
ivr.description: Smart voice menus that shorten the customer journey and connect them to the answer or specialized department within seconds. Supports voicemail and messages during waiting, flexible work schedules for holidays and peak times. Integrates with CRM to enable self-service inquiries about balance, subscriptions, and appointments, reducing waiting time and increasing first-call resolution. Performance reports help you continuously improve pathways.

callEvaluation.title: Call Evaluation & Quality Measurement
callEvaluation.description: Captures customer voice after each interaction through voice surveys or automatic follow-up calls. Converts feedback into actionable performance indicators, with reports at team and individual levels, and recordings for review and training. Reveals service gaps and suggests practical improvements with clear follow-up schedules, monitors compliance with standards and first response time. Result: Superior experience and higher satisfaction.

softphone.title: Softphone Application
softphone.description: Make calls and manage conversations from any device and anywhere without traditional hardware. Supports transfer, hold, recording, and group calls with a lightweight and easy interface. Automatically displays customer card from CRM for accurate and quick responses, with security and privacy policies that protect your data. Ideal for remote teams and multiple offices, reduces operational costs.

voipPhones.title: VoIP / IP Phones & Gateways
voipPhones.description: Reliable infrastructure for clearer voice and more stable connection. IP phones, gateways, and adapters compatible with cloud PBX systems. Quick installation and configuration with training and guarantee of high voice quality and low latency even on congested networks, and 24/7 maintenance and response plans. Compatible with your existing networks for gradual expansion without disruption.

aiAgent.title: Voice/Chat AI Agent
aiAgent.description: Natural conversation assistant that understands Arabic in its dialects and English within the same session. Recognizes intent and context, handles interruptions smoothly, and escalates to staff when needed, conveying full context. Intent and recurring word reports continuously improve scripts and knowledge. Works within our ecosystem or integrates with your systems through flexible interfaces.

ccaas.title: My Contact Omni-Channel Platform (CCaaS)
ccaas.description: Cloud contact center that integrates phone, messages, and digital channels in one interface for teams inside the office and remotely. Quick activation, recording and customer journey analytics, and ready integrations with common systems. High scalability with unified number options and pooled minutes that reduce costs and increase professionalism. Real-time dashboards support immediate decision-making.

crm.title: Customer Relationship Management (CRM)
crm.description: Unified view of every interaction across sales, support, and marketing. Service tickets, automated workflows, deal stages, and follow-up alerts accelerate closure and reduce leakage. Integrates with communication channels to automatically document calls and messages and unify customer data. Customizable dashboards and reports improve conversion and retention.

erp.title: Enterprise Resource Planning (ERP)
erp.description: Connects finance, inventory, and operations with sales channels for consistent data flow and more accurate decisions. Manages invoices, purchases, order tracking, and suppliers, reduces waste and improves cash flow. Real-time executive reports with API integration for stores and channels. Customizable by sector and size with low-risk phased implementation.

aiServices.title: Artificial Intelligence (AI) Services
aiServices.description: Voice and text analytics and conversation summarization reveal patterns and emotions and suggest data-driven responses. Demand and peak hour prediction models to optimize schedules and resource distribution. Intent and content classification reduces processing time and unnecessary escalation. Continuous improvement reports quickly close knowledge gaps.

eTraining.title: E-Training
eTraining.description: Interactive learning platforms for sales and support team certification paths linked to performance indicators. Content, tests, certificates, and progress dashboards identify skill gaps and close them. Supports self-paced and micro-learning to fit busy schedules and reduce traditional training costs. Quick updates when products and policies change.

itOutsourcing.title: IT Outsourcing
itOutsourcing.description: Operation and management of cloud PBX systems and enterprise networks with specialized teams on-site and remotely. Clear service agreements with defined response levels, proactive monitoring, security, and maintenance reduce risks. Documentation, backup, and continuity plans maintain readiness. Focus on your core business while we handle the technology completely.
